subject.title: fix: strip volatile output from exec result hash to fix no-progress detection (#93917)

question: Should stable repeated failed exec outcomes ignore volatile output and be allowed to trip critical/global loop blocking after the configured threshold?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but it deliberately changes when OpenClaw stops agent execution for repeated failed exec calls, so the availability tradeoff needs maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
options.body: Merge after the docs repair and exact-head validation if maintainers agree this is the right default protection against runaway failed exec loops.

options.title: Defer For Broader Loop Policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want fuzzy matching or session-wide loop policy settled before changing failed-exec fingerprints.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Failed-Exec Blocking
recommendation.body: Merge after the docs repair and exact-head validation if maintainers agree this is the right default protection against runaway failed exec loops.
